    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractFileRepository<ID,E>
    In-memory repository whose content is persisted in a text file, one entity per line.
    CommunityService
    Read-only queries about the communities (connected components) of the network.
    Connectivity
    Contract for a structure that tracks the connected components of a dynamic undirected graph.
    ConnectivityLoader
    Fills a Connectivity from the data already stored in the repositories.
    ConsoleUI
    Console interface with a numbered menu that is shown again after every action.
    DynamicConnectivity
    Fully dynamic connectivity for an undirected graph (Holm, de Lichtenberg and Thorup, 2001).
    Entity<ID>
    Base class for all domain entities.
    Friendship
    Basic class for every domain friendship
    FriendshipDbRepository
    Skeleton of the database repository for friendships.
    FriendshipFileRepository
    Repository for managing friendships stored in a file.
    FriendshipValidator
    Validation strategy for friendships.
    InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
    In-memory repository for storing and managing entities.
    LargestCommunityFinder
    Chooses the community with the most users.
    Main
     
    NetworkService
    Entry point of the service layer, used by the UI.
    Repository<ID,E>
    CRUD contract for a repository.
    RepositoryConfig
    Persistence settings, read from a properties file.
    RepositoryException
    Thrown when a persistence operation fails (I/O errors, malformed data, duplicate or missing entities).
    RepositoryFactory
    Simple Factory: the only place in the application that knows the concrete repository classes.
    RepositoryType
    The kinds of persistence the application can use.
    ServiceException
    Custom runtime exception thrown to signal errors occurring in the service layer.
    SociableCommunityFinder
    Strategy for choosing the "most sociable" community among the given ones.
    Tuple<E1,E2>
    Immutable ordered pair, used as composite id (for example for friendships).
    User
    A user of the social network
    UserDbRepository
    Skeleton of the database repository for users.
    UserFileRepository
    Repository for managing users stored in a file.
    UserIdGenerator
    Chooses the id of a new user: the smallest positive id that is not used (mex).
    UsersExistValidator
    Decorator for a friendship validator: besides the checks of the wrapped validator, both users of the friendship must exist.
    UserValidator
    Validation strategy for users.
    ValidationException
    Represents an exception thrown when validation fails.
    Validator<T>
    Strategy interface for validating entities.
